g.text: Clients: the named, reusable configurations that define how MCPJam
connects to and talks to your MCP servers. The original `/hosts` paths
remain as deprecated, ID-only compatibility aliases with their original
DTOs and their original (tokenless) write contracts; every alias response
carries `Deprecation: true`. New integrations should use `/clients`.
Project environments: named, live-editable execution bundles (one host and
an optional standalone server group) that eval suites and goals run
against. Reads require project membership; archiving requires project
